The tallest is Veljko Ilic at 208 cm. The youngest is Nojus Radzius (born 2005) and the most experienced Gabrielius Maldunas (born 1993). Beyond Lithuania, the squad draws most on Serbia (3), France (1) and Switzerland (1). Marius Valinskas and Zygimantas Simonis are back for another spell at the club.
